instruction: Write a complete XDP program that drops IPv4 TCP packets whose destination port is 53 (DNS) and passes all other packets. Ensure safe bounds checking on all headers.
requirements: Drop IPv4 TCP packets with destination port == 53
Pass all other IPv4 TCP traffic, non-TCP IPv4 traffic, and non-IPv4 traffic
Validate packet boundaries before every memory dereference

tests.name: test_match_drop
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet with destination port 53 should be dropped

tests.name: test_diff_port_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet with different port should pass

tests.name: test_udp_pass
tests.description: IPv4 UDP packet to port 53 should pass

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated packet header should safely pass
